title: SHIFT(hold) + NUMBER not working to switch between Fancy zones personal layouts

status.label: Corroborated FancyZones regression
status.detail: Two users report that number-key layout switching during a drag stopped working in 0.101.2362.

next_action.label: Design drag-time layout-switch fix
next_action.reason: The prior behavior, current workaround, and independent confirmation provide a focused regression target.

actions.label: Design FancyZones layout-switch regression fix
actions.note: Trace number-key layout selection during active drags, including Shift and non-primary-button activation modes. This drafts no upstream mutation.

judgment.rationale: The latest release regression is independently confirmed and is not established as a duplicate merely because automated triage found a historical feature request.
evidence: The reporter says Shift+number switched personal layouts during a drag before 0.101.2362 but now does nothing.
Win+Alt+Ctrl+number still switches layouts outside the original drag workflow.
A second user confirms number keys also stopped changing layouts when zone activation is toggled with a non-primary mouse button.
Referenced issue #21277 is closed and documents the historical feature, not a confirmed current duplicate.
judgment.recommended_action: Investigate the current drag input state machine and design regression tests for both Shift and non-primary-button layout selection.
